subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Must Claw v1 introduce an immutable install identity distinct from the mutable final agent ID before this schema becomes the foundation for provenance, update, status, and removal?
rationale: Both choices can be implemented correctly, but changing identity after the downstream ownership stack lands would require compatibility or migration policy that cannot be inferred safely from the patch.

options.title: Add immutable install identity
options.body: Define and bind a stable install ID in the v1 schema and plan before downstream lifecycle contracts depend on agent naming.

options.title: Use agent ID as identity
options.body: Explicitly approve the final agent ID as the permanent install identity and document rename, repeated-install, lookup, and removal semantics.

recommendation.title: Add immutable install identity
recommendation.body: Define and bind a stable install ID in the v1 schema and plan before downstream lifecycle contracts depend on agent naming.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick performed the broadest review against existing canonical configuration, installer, and lifecycle contracts and is the strongest available routing candidate for the foundational decision.
